QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Erasing All Trace
QuestInfo.0: Although you rescued the #t4032775#, it's not entirely over yet. You have one more thing to do. Talk to #b#p2154010##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154010# says everything that you and he have done is probably recorded on #r#o8105001# enemies#k, and the records must be deleted. He says you must eliminate at least #b50#k of them to be sure all records have been deleted from the #o8105001# enemies...

#o8105001##r #a239721##k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated all the #o8105001# enemies. You hope the #t4032775# will be okay now... Fortunately, #p2154010# volunteered to look after the #t4032775#. He said everything will be over if #p2154009# finds out, but he believes he can handle it on his own. He deserves a round of applause for his dedication!

0.0: #t4032775# has been rescued, but it's not over yet. There is one more thing we must do. All traces of evidence of our rescue must be destroyed before #p2154009# finds out.

yes.0: Since we've already taken this child from the laboratory, we don't need to bother erasing clues from there. But we do have to worry about the #o8105001# enemies. They've recorded everything we've done, so go eliminate them. To be sure, destroy at least #r50#k of them. That should do the trick.

no.0: Who knows how #p2154009# would go crazy if he found out what we did.

1.0: You destroyed all the #o8105001#! The only thing left now is deciding what to do with this child, #t4032775#...

yes.0: I will take care of this child until I can release him safely. Getting caught by #p2154009# would be the end of everything, but I am willing to risk it. Thank you so much for what you've done so far.

mob.0: Haven't you destroyed the #r#o8105001# enemies#k yet? You must destroy at least #r50#k to be sure we're safe.
